labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory: the CVE concerns Pygments, a Rich dependency, not Rich's own code.

body:
The Pygments advisory (CVE-2026-4539) concerns the Pygments dependency, which Rich declares in `pyproject.toml` (https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/pyproject.toml). It is not a finding about Rich's own code. The `requests` entry in the output comes from the environment where pip-audit ran, because Rich does not depend on `requests`.

To report a vulnerability privately, please follow https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
